_schema.description: How-to-vote cards registered with the VEC for the 2026 state election, and the preference order each card prints for each district and region it covers. scripts/refresh.py (scripts/vec_htv.py) reads the VEC's register at every refresh; a card's PDF is read once (again only if the VEC replaces it), its order taken from the PDF's text (OCR for scanned cards) and stored only when every number reads cleanly; otherwise the order is marked unreadable and the card is linked. Facts only: the cards belong to whoever registered them. Per-seat copies: htv/<district or region id>.json; counts: htv/index.json.

fields.status: not_open (before 9 am 10 Nov 2026) | open (registration period, to 20 Nov) | closed
fields.source_url: The VEC's register of registered how-to-vote cards
fields.last_checked: ISO UTC time the register was last read successfully
fields.pending: Orders not read yet (cards whose PDF is still to be read, at most a set number per refresh)
fields.coverage: {cards (registrations), listings (card x district or region), orders_read, orders_same_as, orders_unreadable, districts_with_cards, regions_with_cards, by_party: {code | IND (independent candidates) | NONCAND (registered by someone not standing): {cards, districts, regions}}, no_card: {lower, upper (candidates with no card from their party or themselves), candidates_lower, candidates_upper}}
fields.cards: [{registration (VEC number), registered_by (as the VEC lists it), kind (party | independent | non_candidate), party (code; IND for an independent candidate; null for others), candidate (tracker id of the independent it is for), type (Single | Combined | MEHTVC, as listed), registered_on (YYYY-MM-DD), card_url (the VEC's link to the card PDF), file (its file name), areas (district and region ids it is listed under), read_on, orders: {area id: {status (read | partial: numbers only some boxes | same_as: a translated card that couldn't be read, given the order every readable card from the same registrant prints for that seat, with same_as = their registration numbers and note 'same order as the English card' | unreadable | pending), order (Assembly: ballot names, 'SURNAME, Given', first preference first), atl (Council: group letters numbered above the line, first first), btl (Council: ballot names numbered below the line, when the card numbers at least 5), via (text | ocr | hand), note ('unreadable, see card'), ranks ({ALP | LNP | GRN | ONP: preference given to that party's best-placed candidate or group}), flags ([{ahead, of, ahead_n, of_n}]: a Labor, Liberal or Nationals card numbering One Nation or the Greens ahead of the other side of government)}}, notes}]
fields.changes: Cards added, amended (new PDF), moved between areas or removed, as found at each refresh: [{date, kind, registration, registered_by, areas, card_url, detail}], newest first, last 300
